hero.title: Search globally. Travel intelligently.
hero.subtitle: Compare flights, stays, cars, packages and travel experiences across trusted travel providers — then let guided intelligence shape the trip around you.
hero.note: This is the GTAI foundation release. Provider connections, live prices and booking are not active yet.

highlights.title: Guided, not guesswork
highlights.description: Structured questions instead of an open chat box you have to fill in yourself.

highlights.title: Transparent by design
highlights.description: You always see when a link is an affiliate link and who completes your booking.

items.title: Search by flexibility

items.title: Search by interest

items.title: Search by reachability

why.title: Built for how people actually plan travel
why.description: GTAI combines familiar metasearch comparison with structured, explainable planning.

items.title: Global comparison
items.description: One consistent comparison surface across flights, stays, cars and packages.

items.title: Guided intelligent planning
items.description: Structured questions build a trip profile — no blank chat box required.

items.title: Transparent affiliate model
items.description: We show which partner completes your booking and where GTAI earns a commission.

items.title: Travel risk awareness
items.description: Tight connections, long layovers and transit requirements surfaced before you book.

items.title: Personalized travel preferences
items.description: Your saved preferences shape ranking instead of resetting on every visit.

items.title: Multi-provider architecture
items.description: An adapter layer designed so GTAI never depends on a single supplier.

items.title: Multilingual global experience
items.description: Locale routing, RTL layout and regional currency built into the foundation.

items.title: Continued trip support
items.description: Price monitoring and change awareness after you have made a decision.

trust.title: Principles we are building against
trust.description: These are commitments about how GTAI is engineered, not claims about capabilities that already exist.

items.title: Provider transparency
items.description: Every offer will name the provider that supplies it before you leave GTAI.

items.title: Understandable recommendations
items.description: Ranking will be explained in plain language, not presented as an unexplained score.

items.title: Visible affiliate relationships
items.description: Commission-earning links are labelled where they appear, not buried in a policy page.

items.title: Privacy-conscious personalization
items.description: Preferences are built from choices you make, not from tracking or fingerprinting.

items.title: No hidden free-text dependency
items.description: The guided experience works through structured controls rather than an open prompt box.

items.title: User control over preferences
items.description: Saved preferences will be reviewable, editable and deletable by you.

items.title: Future explainable ranking
items.description: Best, cheapest and fastest comparisons will state the trade-off behind each choice.

affiliate.label: Affiliate disclosure
affiliate.short: GTAI is a travel comparison service. Selecting an offer may send you to a partner site that completes the booking and payment, and GTAI may earn a commission.
affiliate.title: How GTAI makes money
points: GTAI compares travel offers published by third-party travel providers.
Selecting an offer may redirect you to a partner website.
The partner — not GTAI — completes the booking and takes the payment.
GTAI may receive a commission when a booking is completed.
Always recheck the price, dates and conditions on the partner site before you pay.
affiliate.notice: No provider is connected in this foundation release, so no offers, prices or affiliate links are shown anywhere on this site.

flights.title: Flight comparison, built for every market
flights.description: The GTAI flight experience will compare fares across approved providers and explain the trade-off between the best, cheapest and fastest options.

planned.title: Best, cheapest, fastest
planned.description: Three clear comparison lenses instead of one opaque ranking.

planned.title: Flexible dates
planned.description: A date grid and price trend view for travellers who can move a day or two.

planned.title: Stop and layover awareness
planned.description: Connection length, airport changes and overnight transits surfaced up front.

planned.title: Transit and visa flags
planned.description: A warning when an itinerary needs a transit visa or a separate ticket.

flights.emptyDescription: Flight providers are not connected in the foundation release. This page shows the intended structure only.

stays.title: Hotels, apartments and everything between
stays.description: The GTAI stay experience will compare accommodation across approved providers, with clarity about what is actually included in the price.

planned.title: Comparable totals
planned.description: Taxes and mandatory fees shown consistently across providers.

planned.title: Location that matters
planned.description: Distance to the things you said you care about, not just to the city centre.

planned.title: Preference-aware ranking
planned.description: Quiet rooms, family space, workspace or accessibility ranked from your profile.

planned.title: Cancellation clarity
planned.description: Refundability and change rules shown before you leave GTAI.

stays.emptyDescription: Accommodation providers are not connected in the foundation release. This page shows the intended structure only.

cars.title: Car rental without the surprises
cars.description: The GTAI car rental experience will compare suppliers and make the real cost of a rental visible before you commit.

planned.title: True cost view
planned.description: Deposit, insurance excess and fuel policy compared side by side.

planned.title: Pick-up reality
planned.description: In-terminal, shuttle or off-airport pick-up stated clearly.

planned.title: Licence requirements
planned.description: Flags when an international permit or a minimum licence age applies.

planned.title: Cross-border rules
planned.description: Whether the vehicle may legally cross the borders on your route.

cars.emptyDescription: Car rental suppliers are not connected in the foundation release. This page shows the intended structure only.

packages.title: Flight, stay and extras — compared together
packages.description: The GTAI package experience will compare bundled travel against the same components booked separately, so the saving is a fact rather than a claim.

planned.title: Bundle versus separate
planned.description: A direct comparison of package price against booking each part alone.

planned.title: What is actually included
planned.description: Transfers, baggage, board basis and extras listed without ambiguity.

planned.title: Flexible components
planned.description: Swap a hotel or a departure without rebuilding the whole trip.

planned.title: Package optimizer
planned.description: A future agent that rebalances the bundle against your stated budget.

packages.emptyDescription: Package providers are not connected in the foundation release. This page shows the intended structure only.

explore.title: Start with a budget, not a destination
explore.description: Explore will let you search outward — from what you can spend, when you can travel and what you enjoy — instead of committing to a city first.

planned.title: Budget-first discovery
planned.description: Set a ceiling and see the destinations that fit inside it.

planned.title: Month-level flexibility
planned.description: Compare a whole month rather than one departure date.

planned.title: Interest matching
planned.description: Discover destinations from the activities you actually want.

planned.title: Reachability filters
planned.description: Limit results by flight time, stops and transit requirements.

trips.title: Your future trip workspace
trips.description: Trips will hold your saved searches, watched routes and planned journeys — once accounts and persistence exist.

planned.title: Saved searches
planned.description: Return to a comparison exactly as you left it.

planned.title: Watched routes
planned.description: Follow a route and be told when the picture changes.

planned.title: Trip timeline
planned.description: Flights, stays and ground transport in one ordered view.

planned.title: Shared planning
planned.description: Plan with the people you are actually travelling with.

aiTravel.title: A travel interview, not a chat box
aiTravel.description: GTAI will build your trip from short structured questions. You choose from clear options, skip anything optional, and the questions adapt as you answer.
aiTravel.notice: Everything on this page is a non-functional preview. No AI model, no agent and no data collection is active.
aiTravel.modesDescription: Pick the depth that matches how much time you want to spend.

modes.name: Quick Match
modes.description: The fast path. Only the essentials needed to make a first useful comparison.
points: Dates and how flexible they are

modes.name: Smart Match
modes.description: Adaptive planning. Questions branch based on what you have already told GTAI.
points: Stay style, location and transport preferences
Risk tolerance, transit concerns and activity interests

modes.name: Perfect Trip Profile
modes.description: A travel profile that keeps improving. You are never shown the whole bank — only what is relevant right now.
points: Questions asked gradually, never all at once
Reviewable, editable and deletable by you

how.title: Only relevant questions
how.description: A business trip and a family holiday will not be asked the same things.

how.title: Adaptive branching
how.description: Each answer narrows what still needs to be asked.

how.title: Optional questions can be skipped
how.description: Skipping never blocks a search — it only makes the ranking less specific.

how.title: Progressive improvement
how.description: Recommendations sharpen as your profile fills in, across trips.

aiTravel.controlsDescription: Non-functional previews of the structured controls the interview will use. Nothing here submits, stores or transmits anything.

controls.selectLabel: What is the purpose of this trip?
controls.cardsLabel: How would you describe your travel pace?

cardsOptions.title: Balanced
cardsOptions.description: A mix of planned and open time

controls.chipsLabel: Which interests should shape this trip?
controls.booleanLabel: Do you need a visa-free transit route?
controls.rankingHint: Preview only — the ranking control is not interactive here.

aiTravel.privacyTitle: What GTAI will never ask for
aiTravel.privacyDescription: The interview is designed around preferences, not identity documents.
privacyItems: No passport numbers or document scans

agents.title: A specialist for each part of a trip
agents.description: GTAI's planning will be split across focused agents, each with a narrow responsibility and an explainable output. None of these are running today.
agents.notice: No agent runtime, no model provider and no AI SDK exists in this release.

items.name: Traveler Profile Agent
items.description: Maintains your structured preferences and keeps them consistent across trips.

items.name: Question Orchestrator Agent
items.description: Decides which question to ask next, and which ones are no longer needed.

items.name: Flight Agent
items.description: Interprets flight options against your route, timing and comfort preferences.

items.name: Stay Agent
items.description: Matches accommodation to location, budget and stay-style requirements.

items.name: Car Rental Agent
items.description: Compares ground vehicle options, true cost and pick-up practicality.

items.name: Activities Agent
items.description: Suggests things to do that fit your interests, pace and time on the ground.

items.name: Budget Agent
items.description: Keeps the whole trip inside the budget you set, across every component.

items.name: Visa and Transit Agent
items.description: Flags transit visa requirements and airport-change complications on a route.

items.name: Risk Agent
items.description: Highlights tight connections, separate tickets and other fragile arrangements.

items.name: Trust Agent
items.description: Assesses provider reliability signals and how consistently offers hold up.

items.name: Package Optimizer Agent
items.description: Rebalances bundled components to find a better overall trip shape.

items.name: Explanation Agent
items.description: Turns ranking decisions into plain language you can disagree with.

items.name: Monitoring Agent
items.description: Watches a saved trip after planning and reports meaningful changes.
